evidence_slice: Newham Council ED008 Local Plan Housing Land Supply Proformas, published 26 November 2025, identifies local plan allocation N8.SA5, Stratford Town Centre West. It records 2,327 dwellings from design-led capacity testing and 4,580 dwellings from planning permissions plus design-led capacity testing, with 4,580 informing the housing trajectory; 4,049 completions are forecast in the plan period and 2,294 in the five years following adoption. Ownership is varied public/private and available; developer interest is confirmed, and listed planning permissions include 20/00274/VAR, 23/00441/FUL, 21/00416/FUL, 19/00391/FUL and 24/00113/FUL.
